test_cases.description: Allowed movement proposes player.current_location from skeld_village to stormcliff.
Applying the validated movement plan in memory updates Player location without changing other state.
User cancellation does not call Commit and does not change the current Save.
A blocked action cannot enter Action Execution.
A conditional action cannot enter Action Execution.
Finding Astrid in the same Location produces an encounter with no State Mutation.
Pure speech produces no State Mutation and does not change Player identity.
Execution Evaluation is read-only and world_seed.json remains unchanged.
